svg.aria-label: Two panels showing the part of matrix A that 1 warp reads at step k = 0. Left, with threadIdx.x down a column of C, the lanes read 16 elements of A in 16 different rows, 1 sector each. Right, with threadIdx.x along a row of C, the warp reads 2 elements of A, each broadcast to 16 lanes.
svg.text: The same kernel with x and y swapped reads A very differently.
A warp is 16 values of threadIdx.x for 2 of threadIdx.y. As the row index, x puts
the warp on 16 rows of A, 16 sectors. As the column index, the warp covers only
2 rows, and the 16 lanes of each row read the same element of A.
